action.argument: cat /workspace/diagnostics/apt.log; cat /etc/os-release; command -v java; command -v tesseract; df -h / /tmp /workspace; mkdir -p /workspace/tmp /workspace/apt-cache /workspace/apt-lists/partial; TMPDIR=/workspace/tmp apt-get -o Dir::State::lists=/workspace/apt-lists -o Dir::Cache::archives=/workspace/apt-cache update > /workspace/diagnostics/apt-retry.log 2>&1 && TMPDIR=/workspace/tmp apt-get -o Dir::State::lists=/workspace/apt-lists -o Dir::Cache::archives=/workspace/apt-cache install -y --no-install-recommends tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-eng >> /workspace/diagnostics/apt-retry.log 2>&1; tail -45 /workspace/diagnostics/apt-retry.log; command -v tesseract
action.why: Diagnose and retry the OCR installation using workspace storage. The chord stage needs an executable recognizer; missing baseline melody artifacts remain a separate blocker to preservation and paired accuracy checks.
